4.1. Declaration
I do hereby solemnly and sincerely declare that the information provided in the form and the
enclosures is:
i. true and correct to the best of my knowledge, in consonance with the record as maintained by

the company and nothing has been concealed; and
ii. hereby reported after complying with and fulfilling all requirements under the relevant
provisions of law, rules, regulations, directives, circulars and notifications whichever is
applicable.
